WEEKLY REPUTATION SYSTEM

HOW MUCH RP?

The weekly board combines actions, ranking, titles and EXP boosts into a visible player progression loop.

HOW RP IS CALCULATED

YOUR ACTIONS
ADD UP.

100 Tokens+5 RP
1 Event Win+10 RP
100 Zombie Kills+2 RP
1 Quest / Contract+5 RP
1 PvP Kill+5 RP
PvP kills by allied / faction-mate are excluded from the ranking rules.

CLAIMABLE OUTPOSTS

CLAIM IT. DEFEND IT.

A resource location can become someone’s territory — and someone else’s target.

FOUR OUTPOST TYPES

DIFFERENT NEEDS.
SAME FIGHT.

Food, Fuel, Medical, Ammo & Weapon. Find an outpost, clear it, restore power, prepare the crate, then claim it through the in-game interaction.

Outposts are PVP territories. Once claimed, they can become a target for factions and solo survivors who want control.

FOODfood supplies
FUELfuel-related needs
MEDICALmedical supplies
AMMO & WEAPONcombat / defense
